contract_excerpt: Section 3.1 Assignment. Assignment requires prior written consent of the other party. No party may assign this Agreement without such consent. Section 4.2 Liability. The total liability cap is one million dollars ($1,000,000) for all claims arising under this Agreement.
The parties agree that audits may occur annually at the licensee's principal place of business upon thirty days written notice. Records shall be maintained for three years.
This Agreement contains no exclusivity provisions. Either party may enter into similar agreements with third parties at any time without restriction.
